name: spec-tree-cleanup
title: The spec tree's provable defects: a duplicated guide block, a mechanism that does not exist, and headings that describe another project
description: Four measured defects in .trellis/spec/: three sections duplicated in the cross-layer guide, a code-reuse guide teaching readTemplate which exists nowhere in this repository, template taglines on both indexes, and headings that name a database and a server this project does not have. Fix the provable ones; change no direction and rename no layer.
